meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: 插件会在 apply_patch、write、edit 等编辑类调用成功后挂上 PostToolUse 钩子。若 comment-checker 报出警告，Codex 会收到阻塞性反馈，需先修正或解释被标记的注释再继续。
howto.when: 在编辑类操作成功后（apply_patch、write、edit 等）comment-checker 报出警告时触发；非编辑工具被忽略，缺少 checker 可执行文件时无输出。

say.text: comment-checker 报了警告，先处理被标记的注释
say.note: 会先修正或说明该注释

say.text: 把触发警告的那条注释改掉，再继续后面的改动
say.note: 改完后继续原本的编辑工作

say.text: 解释一下这条注释为什么被 comment-checker 标记

howto.what_en: Registers a PostToolUse hook after successful apply_patch, write, edit and similar calls. If comment-checker warns, Codex gets blocking feedback and should fix or explain the flagged comment before continuing.
howto.when_en: Triggers after a successful edit-like call when comment-checker reports a warning; non-edit tools are ignored, and missing checker binaries produce no output.

say_en.text: comment-checker flagged a warning - handle the marked comment first
say_en.note: It fixes or explains the comment first

say_en.text: Change the comment that triggered the warning, then continue
Explain why comment-checker flagged this comment
